back_translation: When Ephraim spoke, people trembled with fear; he was once exalted in Israel, but he sinned through Baal and died.
Now they sin more and more; they cast idols from their silver, images skillfully fashioned by craftsmen, all the work of artisans. People say, 'Let those who sacrifice kiss the calves.'
Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the dew that vanishes early, like chaff blown away from the threshing floor, and like smoke escaping through a window.
But I am the LORD your God ever since you were in the land of Egypt; you shall know no God but Me, and there is no Savior besides Me.
It was I who knew you in the wilderness, in the land of drought.
When they had pasture, they were satisfied; when they were satisfied, their heart became proud; therefore they forgot Me.
So I will be to them like a lion; like a leopard I will lurk by the road.
I will attack them like a bear robbed of her cubs; I will tear open their chests; there I will devour them like a lion, and wild beasts will tear them to pieces.
O Israel, you are destroyed, because you have opposed Me—opposed the One who helps you.
Where now is your king to save you in all your cities? And where are your rulers, of whom you said, 'Give me a king and princes'?
So I gave you a king in My anger, and I took him away in My wrath.
The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is stored away.
Pangs like a woman in labor come upon him, but he is an unwise son, for when the time comes he refuses to come out from the womb.
I will ransom them from the power of Sheol; I will redeem them from Death. O Death, where are your plagues? O Sheol, where is your power to destroy? Compassion is hidden from My eyes.

Although he flourishes among his brothers, an east wind will come—the wind of the LORD rising from the wilderness; his fountain will dry up and his spring will fail. That wind will plunder his treasury of every precious thing.
